name: colLogSumExps
title: Accurately computes the logarithm of the sum of exponentials across columns

origin.description: Accurately computes the logarithm of the sum of exponentials across rows or columns.
origin.usage:
colLogSumExps(lx, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, na.rm = FALSE,
  dim. = dim(lx), ..., useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: lx
arguments.text: A numeric N x K matrix. Typically lx are log(x) values.

arguments.name: rows, cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating subset of rows (and/or columns) to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, any missing values are ignored, otherwise not.

arguments.name: dim.
arguments.text: An integer vector of length two specifying the dimension of x, also when not a matrix.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: The native code computes log(sum(exp(lx))) for each column by subtracting the column maximum before exponentiating. It calls the same routine as rowLogSumExps() with byrow FALSE. An empty row selection returns -Inf for each selected column. A missing column index returns -Inf when na.rm is TRUE and NA otherwise.
origin.value: A numeric vector of length K (one value for each selected column).
origin.example:
lx <- matrix(c(0, 0, log(2), log(3)), nrow = 2)
colLogSumExps(lx)

translation.description: Accurately computes the logarithm of the sum of exponentials across rows or columns.
translation.usage:
colLogSumExps(lx, rows=None, cols=None, na_rm=False, dim=None,
              use_names=True)

arguments.name: lx
arguments.text: An N by K array of log values, or a one-dimensional vector when dim is given. A two-dimensional array is read with axis 0 as rows and axis 1 as columns, matching the printed R matrix. A missing double is NaN.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based rows to include. None uses every row. Zeros are dropped and negative values exclude, as in R.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based columns to include. None uses every column. A positive index past the margin is an error.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If True, missing values are excluded. This is na.rm. An all-missing column is -Inf when na_rm is True and NaN otherwise. A missing column index is -Inf when na_rm is True and NaN otherwise.

arguments.name: dim
arguments.text: Two integers giving the shape of lx, also when lx is not a matrix. This is dim. When lx is one-dimensional, the values fill that shape in column-major order.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: Accepted for compatibility with useNames. The result is always a plain float64 vector; names are not attached.

translation.details: Each selected column is passed to the logsumexp crate, which is the max-subtraction sum from matrixStats src/logSumExp.c. The column walk is the rowlogsumexps crate, ported from src/rowLogSumExp.c with hasNA TRUE and byrow FALSE. An empty row selection returns -Inf for each selected column. An empty column selection returns a zero-length vector.
translation.value: A float64 vector of length K, one value for each selected column.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.rowlogsumexps import colLogSumExps

lx = np.array([[0.0, np.log(2.0)], [0.0, np.log(3.0)]])
colLogSumExps(lx)
